inherit_note: every key in 'inherit' is read from <cell run1_cell>/params.json at run time (eval doc ids, budgets, k, W, sinks, seeds, positions, threads), never retyped here; the merged grid is written to results.json key P
calib_rule: the first 3 articles of wiki.valid.raw, in file order, with >= 2048 tokens that are neither run 1 eval docs (0,1,3,4,5,6,7,10) nor in exclude_docs; each calibration doc = the first L tokens of its body (run 1's loader)
exclude_note: doc 13 (Trout Creek Mountains) is used by another round
distance_def: per KV head: mean over its 7 query heads of the mean over rows score_lo..score_hi-1 of sum_{sinks <= j <= t} w[t,j]*(t-j); sink keys contribute 0, no renormalisation; full KV; averaged over the 3 calibration docs; ascending, ties by index
arms_note: distance = the k smallest averaged distances; band and random_s0..s4 = run 1's arms copied from its results.json (identical heads); run 1's single-doc ref arm is not rerun
